summary: Responsive, UI-only console for community and event organizers, combining check-in, imports, moderation, mailing, integrations, audit history, and analytics.
whenToUse: As an operations overview for a community program or event, when the host app owns data and actions.
whenNotToUse: For a public-facing event page or attendee registration flow.
When this component is expected to persist data, send email, call integrations, or make moderation decisions.

props.name: communityName / eventTitle
props.description: Context labels shown in the console header.

props.name: attendees
props.description: Attendee records with registered, checked-in, or no-show status.

props.name: csvPreview
props.description: Externally parsed CSV preview, mapping options, and target fields.

props.name: auditEvents
props.description: Audit history ordered by the host application.

props.name: audienceSegments
props.description: Mailing audience segments and controlled selection state.

props.name: campaign
props.description: Read-only campaign content and delivery statistics.

props.name: attendanceBreakdown
props.description: Event attendance breakdown visualized as accessible labelled bars.

props.name: onCsvMappingChange
props.description: Reports a mapping change; parsing and persistence remain external.

props.name: onImportCsv
props.description: Optional callback to continue the host application import flow.

props.name: onPreviewCampaign

props.name: onManageIntegration
props.description: Optional callback for the host to manage integration setup.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class on the console root.

inherits: All record data is supplied by the consumer; callbacks are omitted to render a read-only UI.

keyboard.action: Moves through actions, mapping controls, and audience checkboxes.
Activates buttons and toggles audience selection.
Uses native select behavior for CSV column mapping.

accessibility: Section titles use headings; attendee and CSV data use captioned semantic tables.
Status is communicated by text as well as color, and analytics bars include an accessible text summary.
Audience checkboxes are controlled by the consumer and are disabled without a change callback.
responsive: The two-column work areas collapse to one column on narrow viewports; tables scroll in their own labelled regions.
customization: Provide only the data and callbacks relevant to a deployment; omitted collections render concise empty states.
commonMistakes: Treating callbacks as backend operations: they are delegated to the host application.
Passing raw CSV content: supply only parsed preview rows and do persistence in the host.
Using campaign preview as a send action: no email delivery is implemented.

limits: No persistence, CSV parsing, sending, integration/API calls, or moderation backend.
Filtering, pagination, sorting, and data fetching are owned by the host application.
